## Follow-up: rotate externally anchored secrets flagged during value_wo state remediation

During gnarly-sinistrous-groundhog execution, operator approval limited autonomous rotation to internally generated/self-regenerable secrets. The following names still require human/operator coordination because they are third-party credentials, externally trusted keys, or rotations that require updating external trust stores/consumers outside the safe autonomous boundary: /rebar/prod/anthropic-api-key, /rebar/prod/jira-api-token, /rebar/prod/gerrit-admin-password, /rebar/prod/gerrit-bot-token, /rebar/prod/gerrit-ssh-host-ed25519-key, /rebar/prod/github-replication-deploy-key, /rebar/prod/github-oauth-client-id, /rebar/prod/github-oauth-client-secret, /rebar/prod/g2p-github-pat, /rebar/prod/ci-gerrit-ssh-key, /rebar/prod/reviewbot-tickets-pat, /rebar/prod/rebar-bot-signing-key, /rebar/prod/opcert-ed25519-key, /rebar/prod/mcp-client-pat-copilot, /rebar/prod/mcp-client-pat-codex, /rebar/prod/mcp-client-pat-claude, /rebar/prod/mcp-tickets-pat, /auth-solutions/COOKIE_SIGNING_SECRET, /auth-solutions/GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Each listed secret has an owner-approved rotation plan that names the external trust update required, without recording secret values.
- [ ] Each listed secret is rotated by an operator who can reissue/update the corresponding external credential or trust store.
- [ ] Every affected consumer is restarted/redeployed and verified healthy after its rotation.
- [ ] Completion comments record only secret names and verification evidence, never values.

## Verification
- For each secret name, verify the corresponding AWS SSM parameter version advanced or the owning external system reports a new credential/key in use.
- Verify Gerrit, review-bot, opcert, MCP, bridge/Jira, GitHub Actions, SSO, and any OAuth consumers remain healthy after their respective rotations.
